summary: CDF fire lookout in Tehama County; a 1970 tower and cab replaced an earlier CCC lookout. Unstaffed in a 2016 photo note and managed by Cal Fire.

facts.design: Shortest steel K-brace tower in California; early version of the standard CDF 732-6A cab

visit.trail_note: The register says the site is some 7 miles from the nearest paved road.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Peakbagging says the lookout sits on National Forest land that CalFire manages. The register names the Tehama-Glenn Unit as administrator. Both can be true.

notes_for_editor: Elevation conflict: the register gives 3,975 ft (1,212 m), Peakbagging gives 4024 ft; the record uses the register value. No source gives access level, so no access key. Current status after the 2016 photo note is unknown. Photo: a public-domain 1952 outhouse photo is on Internet Archive (casbcfm_000230); the direct image file URL was not captured, so no photos entry was added.
